steps: Cut the seat panel from the top panel, avoiding existing screw holes.
Cut the left and right upright supports to matching dimensions from the two side panels.
Pre-drill pilot holes along the top edge of both upright supports.
Position the upright supports under the ends of the seat panel with an overhang.
Fasten the seat panel securely to each upright support using wood screws.
